FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Green Horizons Landscaping, we specialize in providing high-quality garden and landscaping services tailored primarily for residential clients. Our core operations include routine lawn care, flower bed maintenance, and plant installation, focusing on enhancing outdoor aesthetics while promoting healthy plant growth. We have cultivated strong relationships with licensed nurseries and reputable material suppliers to ensure that we utilize the best materials available for our services. While we may perform incidental tree trimming and removal, it is not a central part of our business operations, aligning with our commitment to maintaining a safe work environment while minimizing risks. Additionally, our team is dedicated to maintaining compliance with all local regulations, including proper certifications for any incidental pesticide or herbicide applications, if required. We pride ourselves on providing reliable, environmentally-friendly services while ensuring customer satisfaction through clear communication and detailed project proposals.

Our landscaping services include regular tree trimming and removal to maintain the health and aesthetics of the properties we service, ensuring that our clients' gardens thrive and look their best.
